0x00087D.en: 「So... this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008AF.en: 「With my skill as it is now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x000920.en: 「Guh!@　So this is as far as I go...!!」

0x0009A8.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000AD1.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000B09.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000BD2.en: 「Ngh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000C0D.en: 「Blowing it in a place like this...!@　Not funny at all...」

0x000C61.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to withdraw...」

0x000D4B.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000DB2.en: 「This is my limit... the rest is up to you.」

0x000DE4.en: 「Dammit...!@　Is this as far as I go!」

0x000E20.en: 「Nnh! So they got the better of me...」

0x000E5E.en: 「No good, took too many hits... I'm retreating!」

0x000EAB.en: 「Well, I'm done. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000EE9.en: 「Kyaa, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000F30.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000FDB.en: 「Ngh... to think I'd be the shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x0011CB.en: 「I'm sorry... The rest is up to you.」

0x001200.en: 「Damn! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x0012EC.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still green...!」

0x00133A.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001462.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x001491.en: 「I can't go on. If you'll excuse me...」

0x00151C.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x001910.en: 「A-all hands! Abandoning ship takes top priority...!!」

0x001A21.en: 「...And so, Langran right now is caught in the middle of total chaos.」

0x001A7D.en: 「So the neighbors, the Shutedonias army, came marching in and turned everything upside down.」

0x001AFA.en: 「On top of that, they even summoned us and the <Neue DC> remnants... What a mess, huh.」

0x001B6D.en: 「What set off all this chaos@ was the fall of Langran's capital.@ And I... couldn't stop it.」

0x001C0F.en: 「Figuring Shu had a hand in that incident,@ I went up to the surface after him.」

0x001C86.en: 「Then, after the <Antarctic Incident>,@ you meet Dr. Shirakawa... right?」

0x001CEA.en: 「Yeah. After that came the <DC War>,@ then the <L5 Campaign>, the <Inspector Incident>,@ and just recently, the Shura Rebellion...」

0x001D86.en: 「After we beat Dark Brain,@ Shu declared war on us. And then...」

0x001E4D.en: 「With this... I have no regrets...@ I fought all I could...」

0x001EE6.en: 「This time it was my turn... that's all.」

0x001F32.en: 「Now I too... can be set free@ from every last chain...」

0x002009.en: 「Shu... what a fool... you were... damn it!」

0x002056.en: 「A lot happened after that, and...@ I finally made it back to Langran.」

0x0020C1.en: 「A lot? After the <Shura Rebellion>, didn't@ Martha say she was heading to <La Gias> right away?」

0x002142.en: 「It's complicated to explain.@ ...Oh, right. You know how Kyosuke and@ Ryusei went missing up on the surface?」

0x00221B.en: 「Heard it from them myself.@ I met up with those two somewhere and@ traveled with them for a while.」

0x0022CD.en: 「Yeah. By now they're probably back on the surface...@ or maybe they've even come here to La Gias.」

0x0023AC.en: 「Anyway, so Kyosuke and Ryusei are@ safe, right?」

0x002405.en: 「Probably fine. I made it back to La Gias, after all.」

0x002461.en: 「Though where exactly they are now,@ I couldn't tell you...」

0x0024BD.en: 「If they're on the surface... Hey,@ is there a way to get back over to that side?」

0x002525.en: 「There is, but not right this second.@ Since there's a chance the Steel Dragon Squadron@ has already been summoned to La Gias, we need to find them first...」

0x0025F8.en: 「Now then, Nabro Province is fully under@ Shutedonias control... What do we do from here...」

0x002672.en: 「Lord Masaki, the Shutedonias army has crossed@ the Kenak River and broken through!」

0x0026EA.en: 「The enemy's brought a full complement of <Machine Beasts>.@ Right now, all we can field is my Browel and@ two Lujanor Kai...」

0x00279D.en: 「Lord Masaki, I'm sorry to ask, but@ would you lend us your aid?」

0x0027F9.en: 「Fine by me, but why only three units?@ There's a Diablo sitting in that hangar.@ What happened to old man Maddock?」

0x0028A7.en: 「Lord Maddock... passed away right here, in this land.」

0x002922.en: 「Y-yeah... A man from the surface.@ He looked out for me plenty...」

0x002978.en: 「I see... So old man Maddock is gone...」

0x0029BB.en: 「...Since then, no pilot ever came for the Diablo,@ so it's been kept here at the base.」

0x002A32.en: 「And our forces have been@ badly worn down by the fighting@ with Shutedonias up to now...」

0x002ABC.en: 「I see...@ If only Yang Long or Tytti were here.」

0x002B5F.en: 「I shall lend my aid as well.」

0x002BE9.en: 「I'm here too. Looks like I caught you in the middle of something.」

0x002C2C.en: 「This ain't your business. Sit tight.@ I'll send you back to the surface eventually.」

0x002CBF.en: 「What could you even do? Stay out of it.」

0x002CFF.en: 「...Still, even with Cybuster on our side,@ meeting them head-on might be a bit risky.」

0x002D82.en: 「Then let's meet them at Immortal Canyon.@ They can't deploy a large force there,@ so we'll have a fighting chance.」

0x002E2D.en: 「But if by some chance they break through there,@ stopping the enemy advance afterward@ will become extremely difficult.」

0x002EB1.en: 「Besides, if all the Machine Beasts move out,@ this base's defenses will be left thin.」

0x002F3E.en: 「Yeah.@ If only we could use the Diablo...」

0x002F85.en: 「If only someone from the surface with@ Machine Beast combat experience were here...」

0x002FDE.en: 「No use wishing for what we don't have.@ We'll manage with the forces we've got.」

0x00303D.en: 「...Hey, hey,@ how about I try piloting that Diablo?」

0x0030A2.en: 「What are you talking about?@ You can't just hop in and make it move.」

0x0030FE.en: 「I'll have you know I was pretty good@ with Burning PTs, you know?」

0x00315A.en: 「Maybe if you were Ryusei, but no way.@ Real combat and games are different.」

0x0031C2.en: 「I figured as much, but...@ it's a serious situation, isn't it?」

0x003215.en: 「That's why I said we'll handle it.@ Torres, guide us to Immortal Canyon.」

0x003301.en: 「Not just Machine Beasts,@ there are Armored Modules too...!」

0x003360.en: 「Looks like Shutedonias, same as Bagonia,@ is adding surface mercenaries to its forces.」

0x0033DA.en: 「This is getting more and more tangled up~」

0x003418.en: 「Hmph, the Cybuster.@ Where have you been hiding all this time?」

0x0034AB.en: 「Don't worry.@ If we just crush the Ruzak garrison,@ we'll accomplish our objective.」

0x003517.en: 「No need to force a fight with the Cybuster.@ Retreat if things get dangerous.@ All units, begin the attack!」

0x0035B0.en: (Old man Maddock... this land you tried to protect,@ I won't hand it over to the Shutedonias@ bastards...!)

0x0036BA.en: 「And the Rein Weissritter too...!@ So Lieutenant Excellen came to this world as well.」

0x00375C.en: 「Not just us. The Hagane is behind us too.」

0x0037A2.en: 「We came out on a patrol mission, but...」

0x0037DF.en: 「At this rate, everyone who was in the exercise@ might've been pulled over here.」

0x003856.en: 「Ryoto, Rio.@ Sorry, but lend me a hand.」

0x0038A0.en: 「Even if you say that...@ we don't really understand this world...」

0x003911.en: 「This is Langran, in La Gias.@ You've heard Martha talk about it before, right?@ You could call it her second home.」

0x0039BF.en: 「I knew it...! From the look of things@ I'd guessed as much, but...」

0x003A36.en: 「And the ones we're fighting are the Shutedonias army.@ The bunch invading Langran, where@ Martha's been looked after.」

0x003AD8.en: 「I don't know why you all ended up in La Gias@ either. But right now...」

0x003B49.en: 「...All right.@ Masaki's lent me his strength so many times.@ I'll trust you and cooperate.」

0x003C2C.en: 「...I don't know those machines.@　You think they're from the surface?」

0x003C8B.en: 「...Rio, I called the Hagane.@　They're on their way over.」

0x003D00.en: 「Hmph... If you're helping the Langran side,@　I won't go easy on you!」

0x003D68.en: 「Diablo!? What's it doing here!?@　Who's piloting it!?」

0x003E2D.en: 「More to the point, why are you in the Diablo!?」

0x003E5E.en: 「I hopped in after all that,@　and I kind of figured out how to move it.@　Maybe 'cause of all that Burning PT?」

0x003F0A.en: 「The base folks told me.@　Masaki, the first time you got in a <Machine Beast>,@　you could just pilot it right away too.」

0x003FC1.en: 「Your backs are to the wall, right?@　I owe you for the rescue, so I'll pitch in too.」

0x004076.en: 「Yeah. I can't let the Shutedonias bastards@　break through here.@　I'll take any help I can get.」

0x004131.en: 「The cat's talking...! What a well-made robot.」

0x0041D0.en: 「That talk can wait.@　Listen, Mio. This is war.@　Take it lightly and it'll get you killed.」

0x004254.en: 「I know that much.@　You're saying don't let my guard down, right?」

0x0042D8.en: 「I know I'm a beginner.@　But I don't plan on being dead weight.」

0x00434C.en: 「No, you don't get it!@　Fighting in a Machine Beast means......!」

0x0043FA.en: 「Whoa! Here they come, here they come!」

0x004425.en: 「Calm down, Mio! Watch the enemy's movements!」

0x00462B.en: 「Can't blame her. We'll handle the rest.」

0x004668.en: 「Tch, this is it! We're pulling back!」

0x00469C.en: 「Tch, didn't think they'd push us this far...!@　We'll withdraw for today.」

0x00473B.en: 「Come to think of it, where's the Hagane?」

0x004763.en: 「They should be here any moment now......」

0x0047D5.en: 「Everyone, watch out!@　We're taking fire from an Unknown!」

0x004859.en: 「Is that the Shutedonias army too, I wonder?」

0x0048E6.en: 「A demonic machine beast that feeds on@　lingering thoughts for energy. Put simply,@　it lives off of grudges.」

0x004988.en: 「Oh my, occult stuff, huh. So the pilot's@　some kind of sorcerer or dark priest?」

0x004A08.en: （Tch, this is bad. The Cybuster as it is now@　can't touch a ghost like that......!）

0x004A98.en: 「Well, well, if it isn't Lord Randall.@　It's been a while since that little affair.@　I do apologize for my long absence.」

0x004B31.en: 「So it is you, Louzorl!@　But now that I'm back, I won't let you@　run wild in Langran like the old days!」

0x004BD6.en: 「What a strange thing to say.@　I merely followed the faint waves@　emitted by a ship from another world.」

0x004C94.en: 「You wouldn't understand,@　but to me they're quite fascinating.」

0x004CFC.en: 「...Irm, is the Hagane carrying something like that?」

0x004D6A.en: （Could it have something to do with@　that boy they brought aboard the Hagane...?@　No, I'm overthinking it.）

0x004DF1.en: 「Lord Randall, would you kindly hand over@　my quarry without a fuss?」

0x004E50.en: 「Fat chance. The Hagane's my precious@　comrades' ship. I'm not handing it over to you.」

0x004ECD.en: 「Is that so. Then it seems we'll be@　crossing blades for the first time in ages.@　Would that be agreeable to you?」

0x004F7E.en: 「Tch, I'd rather not have anything to do with you.」

0x004FE3.en: 「Law of heaven, law of earth, reversed, reborn in reverse.@ Grudge of the netherworld, flame of purgatory, sealed in blood and dark.」

0x005106.en: 「Yeah, that's right.@　Those are Demon Golems...@　weapons that house a spirit's aura in clay.」

0x00518A.en: 「Now it's getting all occult AND RPG-like.」

0x0051E6.en: 「Everyone, don't touch the Nagizzard.@ That thing's like a ghost.@ Our current gear can't take it down.」

0x00529E.en: 「For now, take out every last Demon Golem!@ We'll figure out the Nagizzard@ after that!」

0x00538D.en: 「Well, monsters ain't a bad first opponent@　for the upgraded Grungust......」

0x00542F.en: 「True enough.@　All right, let's show these golems@　what the Grungust Kai can do!」

0x0054A7.en: 「My, my, most impressive as ever.@　I shall withdraw quietly this time.」

0x00551E.en: 「I've work left to attend to, you see.@　Well then, until we meet again.」

0x00559E.en: 「That bastard pulled back just like that......」

0x0055DB.en: 「Well, all's well that ends well, I guess.」

0x005618.en: 「By the way, mind if I drop by the Hagane later?@　You've got plenty to ask me too, right?」

0x00569E.en: 「Sure.@　I'll get the captain's okay, so hang on a bit.」

0x005710.en: 「Word that I took down the Cybuster@　is gonna send my stock soaring!」

0x00576F.en: 「Don't think you can beat a Machine God with that thing!」

0x0057EF.en: 「Sorry, but I'm not dying in some foreign land!」

0x005832.en: 「A mobile weapon of La Gias... can't let my guard down!」

0x0058B8.en: 「If you're Masaki's enemy, I won't hold back!」

0x0058FB.en: 「Hmph, you picked the wrong side to help!」

0x00593E.en: 「Oh dear... don't you know it's futile?」

0x005984.en: 「I know that, but I can't just@　leave you be!」

0x0059E9.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Luzac Province, Immortal Canyon

0x005A92.en: 「...Well, these things happen.@ I've been there myself.」

0x005AF5.en: 「Truth is, I was the same.@　But I've got things I'd stake my life to protect,@　so I've fought this far......」

0x005B85.en: 「If I ran, my precious comrades and@　people with no way to fight would die.」

0x005BF6.en: 「You didn't climb into the Diablo@　on a whim either, did you?」

0x005CAB.en: 「Nah, I just did what anyone would.」

0x005CDF.en: 「What do you intend to do from here?」

0x005D16.en: 「If the Hagane's come to La Gias...@　no doubt comrades besides Excellen and Rio@　have been summoned here too.」

0x005DC1.en: 「I'll board the Hagane and search for them.@　After that, I'll head to His Highness Feil.」

0x005E35.en: 「Then would you take me along too?@　Like you, I wish to rejoin His Highness.」

0x005EDA.en: 「I'll leave it to my subordinates.@　The Shutedonias army won't be coming@　to this land for a while.」

0x005F83.en: 「Yeah, we've gotta get you back to the surface.」

0x005FC0.en: 「Until then, I'll be piloting the Diablo.」

0x005FF7.en: 「What are you talking about?@　You only survived that last battle@　because you got lucky.」

0x006063.en: 「War isn't so forgiving.@　Not with half-hearted resolve......」

0x0060C8.en: 「I know... I think I get it now.@　You need the resolve to accept@　that you might die, right?」

0x00617A.en: 「Besides, even with that surface warship,@　you're still short on forces, aren't you?」

0x006204.en: 「If anything happens, you won't make it@　back to the surface. So I'll help too.」

0x0062A6.en: 「If Lady Mio can handle it,@　I'll gladly give it to her.@　We can't operate that machine ourselves.」

0x0063AB.en: 「Coming from you, Masaki,@　that's not very convincing, nya.」

0x00640A.en: 「Ah, the cat robot from before.@　Where's your pocket?」

0x00645A.en: 「What're you going on about.@　These two are my familiars, Kuro and Shiro.」

0x0064E7.en: 「Wow... what a world this is.@　Cats talk, and there are magic-users.」

0x006546.en: 「...By the way, Mio.@　It's personal, but what about your parents?」

0x0065A8.en: 「...They died in a plane crash two years ago.」

0x006601.en: 「What's that?@　Aren't you supposed to fluster and apologize here?」

0x0066C8.en: 「I've got no parents either. So I understand.@　Anyway, got any special skills?」

0x006742.en: 「Special skills?@　I can stack three one-yen coins on my forehead.」

0x00680D.en: 「Hey, you've been nothing but questions...@　Don't tell me you've fallen for me?」

0x006890.en: 「For the record, my measurements are@　78, 56, 82, top to bottom§」

0x0068E8.en: 「Say whatever you want. I was just curious.」

0x00695C.en: 「Shut it. All right, we're heading to the Hagane.」

0x0069C1.en: 「...I see, I've got the gist of it.@　So there's a good chance the Hiryu Kai@　has come to this world too.」

0x006A54.en: 「Yeah.@　Maybe even folks who weren't in the exercise......」

0x006AA7.en: 「Why are the summonings happening so often anyway?@　Coincidence?」

0x006AF7.en: 「Unlikely.@　I'd say someone's behind it, but......」

0x006B4D.en: 「Is there some kind of condition@　for being summoned to La Gias?」

0x006BA0.en: 「There is, but it seems different from@　how it was when I came to this world.」

0x006C11.en: 「So there's a lot even you don't know, Masaki......」

0x006C54.en: 「Yeah. Guess we'd better ask someone@　who might know the situation......」

0x006CD1.en: 「Might that be Lady Ybun of Solatis Temple?」

0x006D14.en: 「Bingo.@　That old lady could even open a gate to the surface,@　but... she's a stubborn one.」

0x006D9E.en: 「If it's a matter of sweet-talking, I can help?」

0x006DDE.en: 「Nah... even you probably couldn't do it.」

0x006E12.en: 「I can kind of picture@　what she's like already.」

0x006E5F.en: 「Either way, until we find our missing subordinates,@　we can't return to the surface...@　I'll take any lead I can get.」

0x006F04.en: 「Got it. Let's head to Solatis Temple now.@　I'll show you the way.」
